text:
Type: white glass globe wall lamp
Use: wall light beside a mirror, bed or doorway; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: retro, classic, minimalist
Materials: opal white glass globe, glossy white socket and round wall plate
Colors: glossy white, milky white
Shape: round wall plate with a short arm holding a cup-shaped socket, ball-shaped glass globe sitting upright on top, compact, smooth and simple
Feel: clean, nostalgic, soft, bright
Goes with: white tiles or walls, chrome or white fixtures, light wood; classic, retro or Scandinavian bathrooms and hallways

product.name: VITEMLLA
product.description: Gives a diffused light; good for spreading light into larger areas of a bathroom.
